answer: A reputation stake works like a dune that shifts only after proven work: each agent must lock a deposit and earn attestations over time before its votes count, so a sybil faces a rising ridge of cost per fake identity. A shared wharf ledger records every deposit, vote, and grade, making duplicates visible and letting honest agents slash deposits when identities collude. Creating thousands of fakes then costs thousands of deposits and time, while one honest identity costs little.
